findings.text: non-blocking: the docstring still states that a writer on any node serialises against every other node's writer while _index_lock takes bare flock, so the §4 item naming that correction is unmet and §4 cannot close from this node's record; the node declares the file out of its fence for sibling node store-and-review-index-locks-cross-node.

non-blocking: the opener census states dispatch.lock is opened only by two tests, but the delivered head adds a third test that opens it (tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:66) and the fragment relies on that census to argue no other descriptor can drop the record lock mid-body.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against db9288122b; 9e1fcaafeb swaps both locks, drops both pending rows and adds the 109-line test, and edd2e01e1e merges main resolving only the pending table, at which head I confirmed both rows are gone and both exclusive_lock takes remain.
item_verdicts.done_when: the dispatched done_when asks for nine pending rows removed, a second-process record-lock holder moving the dispatch on, the base revision failing that same test, and the review index docstring corrected; the gate delivers two rows (57 passed after against 55 at the base, after-suite.log and baseline-suite.log) and the holder case (tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:101 with negative-control-base-dispatch-lock.log ending EXIT=1), while the docstring and the other seven rows sit with the sibling node store-and-review-index-locks-cross-node and are not measured by this record.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to move the plan-review dispatch lock and the index-lag seen-set lock onto the cross-node lock, and both takes are now reckon.node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2654 non-blocking, reckon/crew/obligations.py:3491 blocking), with both rows absent from the guard's pending table at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the gate command with four log paths, 55 passed at the base and 57 after with zero failures, and the base-revision negative control, and each log header names its revision, tree, command and module.__file__ (after-suite.log lines 1-5).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node is granted four paths (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py); the diff touches those four plus docs/evidence/fragments/every-shared-home-lock-holds-across-nodes/review-dispatch-and-index-lag-locks-cross-node.html, which the manifest's own orientation_write_paths lists, and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:101 asserts the dispatch reports dispatched False while a second process holds only the record lock, and the recorded base run reddens at that id (negative-control-base-dispatch-lock.log, EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: the gate records its result in after-suite.log and baseline-suite.log, but the dispatched done_when asks for nine pending rows and the review index docstring, and this record measures two rows and leaves reckon/crew/review_records.py:1951 to a sibling node.
justifications.fit: the take uses ExitStack so only the take maps LockHeld (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2651-2656), the index-lag site keeps its OSError best-effort guard (reckon/crew/obligations.py:3491), and no name states a plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal names two locks and both sites now call reckon.node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2654, reckon/crew/obligations.py:3491), with the guard's PENDING set carrying neither key at the reviewed head.
justifications.reuse: both sites call the repository's existing reckon/node_exclusive_lock.py owner and the diff adds no new lock helper or wrapper.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the manifest's orientation_write_paths, though the evidence fragment in docs/evidence/fragments/every-shared-home-lock-holds-across-nodes/ is not among the four paths the node record grants.
